question: Which ritual occasions are specified for the addressed beloved in this context?
premises: A śrāddha at Gayā is named
The fortnight of ancestors is named
Following in death is also named
inference: The verse specifies Gayā śrāddha, the ancestor fortnight, and following in death as occasions.
uncertainties: The main action for these occasions is not stated in this verse
plain_english: O beloved, at a śrāddha in Gayā, in the fortnight of the ancestors, and likewise at the time of following in death...
